commands.command: cargo clippy --manifest-path flashloan/tools/Cargo.toml -p token-manager -p manager-api -p pool-manager --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings

apiContract.applyTransaction: IMMEDIATE; status, library state/version/checksum, admission event, and idempotency record commit atomically
apiContract.dryRun: computes the same read/version/checksum preview and rolls back every write
apiContract.idempotentReplay: same key and request digest returns the original result with idempotentReplay=true
apiContract.idempotencyConflict: same key with a different request digest returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED / HTTP 409

testCoverage: missing headers and missing explicit dryRun are rejected
dry-run and apply compute the same checksum
dry-run does not persist token state, library version, or events
apply increments version once and writes one admission event
same-content idempotent replay does not increment version or add an event
different-content idempotency-key reuse returns a stable conflict
conclusion: D1.2.2 passes with atomic admission writes, explicit dry-run semantics, idempotency replay/conflict handling, and no mainnet business write.
